Instead of multi layer pictures, consider turning off the environment.

You can also tell OBS to capture alpha channel from the window, but keep in mind that if you've got the environment layer on, not all worlds are perfect on the alpha channel being correct, so I turn off the capture of alpha channel when I don't need it.

details:
I love filming different things in VRChat making content on different social platforms. Having more access to camera features would be very beneficial for making good quality content and could motivate more people to make content themselves. It could also bring in more people to give VRChat a try. Some ideas I believe would be beneficial would be:

Adding camera animations allowing people to make different points (ex. 1, 2, 3) and have the camera slowly transition between these points. Allowing different speeds and animations like sharp or smooth would make videos look all the more better. Adjusting the zoom between different points would be great for action shots as well! (ex. point 1 has 25% zoom, point 2 has 75%)

Having the camera follow other users besides yourself would also be very nice. Switching between different users or yourself should also include the choice between smooth or sharp.

Using free cam in vertical would be great for filming videos that are meant for the phone rather than it only being locked to horizontal. I think a feature as simple as this would be a huge difference. I know you'd like it for your TikToks, VRChat. *wink* *wink*

Different green screen options besides only green would be very nice to include. Some avatars are green or have green on them and having different options like red or blue would be definitely helpful. Having to switch to different green screen worlds just to do a chroma key shot is very inconvenient when it could just be on the camera itself. The VRChat camera's green screen is also not 100% green and makes chroma keying a little more difficult.

When taking pictures of either yourself or other users, it would be nice to make them a transparent png without having to click the multi layer button. It's a little unfortunate to have to delete every background picture. It's a little nitpicky but make the camera just a little better.
title: VRChat's Stream Camera Should Have More Features
